outreach.subject: Example Company: one testable workflow question
outreach.body:
Hello Decision Owner,

I am preparing a small, evidence-led work sample for Example Company. The current file contains placeholders, not conclusions about your business. Before any outreach, I will replace them with dated public sources, mark each inference, and define one workflow question that a process owner can confirm or reject.

The final page will show the evidence, unknowns, human decision points, metric, and stop rule without invented ROI. I am exploring AI workflow roles where I can own this careful preparation.

Would 15 minutes be useful once the evidence is complete?

Candidate Name
outreach.optOut: If this is not relevant, reply no and I will not follow up.
